description: §51.0.S.2.3 / §19.4.5 / §63.5 — engine message arms written with the soft-deprecated leading `|` (the twin of engine/message-dispatch). The deprecated form is in-contract during the window: one W-ARM-PIPE-LEGACY (Info) per `|`-led arm (2 here), and the runtime is identical — a click calls @gate.advance(.Toggle) and the engine transitions Closed -> Open. The legacy spelling is the PURPOSE of this case; it is not migrated.
rationale: §51.0.S.2.3 — a `|`-led message arm parses identically to the §18.2 match arm and surfaces W-ARM-PIPE-LEGACY (§19.4.5, one per arm). §63.5 — during the window the W-code is conformance-required and the runtime is identical to the canonical form's (engine/message-dispatch).
